title: Terminal Layouts Schema
description: Schema for stackops terminal layout YAML files (layout.yaml).

layoutTabs.description: Tabs to open for this layout.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the layout in the file without launching it. Defaults to true. A layout that is off still launches when it is named with --choose-layouts or picked from the list.

tabName.description: Tab title shown in terminal (tmux window, tuios workspace, herdr tab).

panes.description: Panes shown side by side inside the tab (tmux pane, tuios window, herdr pane).

arrangement.description: How the panes share the tab: side by side, stacked, or a balanced grid. Defaults to grid. TUIOS ignores it because its tiler arranges the windows of a workspace.

tabWeight.description: Optional weight for tab sizing, defaults to 1 if not provided.

enabled.description: Set to false to leave the tab out when its layout launches. Defaults to true. A tab that is off still launches when it is named with --choose-tabs or picked from the list.

paneName.description: Pane title, unique within its tab.

startDir.description: Directory to start the pane in (supports ~ expansion).

command.description: Shell command to execute when the pane opens.

enabled.description: Set to false to leave the pane out when its tab launches. Defaults to true. A tab whose panes are all off is left out too.
